vendor.name: Amar Tutorials
vendor.shortBio: Amar Tutorials has been providing guidance to hundreds of students every year. Since its inception in 1999, Amar Tutorials has been conducting offline and online interactive classes of CAT for IIMs, NMAT for NMIMS, and MH CET & other MBA Entrances. Moreover, we have an excellent track record in NPAT coaching for NMIMS, SET coaching and other BBA Entrances. Also, through offline and online live classes, Amar Tutorials has been preparing students for CLAT for National Law Universities and other Law Entrances. Thus, our students have been placed in various top business schools, including IIMs, for numerous MBA, BBA and other Business Management Programs through our Online Interactive Coaching, Offline Onsite Coaching and Exclusive Home Tuitions in Mumbai and Thane.
